description: Secure Logistics-Trax Group Limited is the listed group behind SLGTrax, which describes itself as Pakistan's first technology-enabled 4PL logistics platform. The group was formed by the strategic merger of Secure Logistics Group and Trax through a scheme of arrangement in 2025, after listing on the Pakistan Stock Exchange with an IPO in 2024. It says it operates through five legal entities covering logistics, last-mile delivery, warehousing, asset tracking and security services.
headOffice: 10th Floor, New State Life Tower, Islamabad, Pakistan
